name: Pluxo Blueprint
author: pluxo

sections.description:
Pluxo Blueprint helps you document your installed WordPress plugins by displaying detailed plugin information and exporting the plugin inventory to CSV, JSON, or Markdown.

Features

  • View a detailed table of installed plugins
  • Export plugin inventory to CSV, JSON, or Markdown
  • Ideal for documentation in tools like Confluence, Notion, or OneNote
  • No external services or tracking
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Pluxo → Blueprint
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data externally?

No. All data stays inside your WordPress installation.

Is this plugin free?

Yes. This is the free version of Pluxo Blueprint.
